prompt: A single small measuring buoy floating on the open sea, seen from slightly above: a round float low in the water carrying one upright round instrument dial facing the viewer, the dial face plain off-white with a curved arc scale along its upper half made only of short plain tick marks, and one slender needle pivoting from the centre of the dial and pointing up and to the right at the scale, the tip of the needle forest green #2F7A55. The float, the dial rim, the tick marks and the needle shaft are drawn in crisp off-white and ink grey line art with fine engraved shading; only the needle tip is green. The dial face is blank apart from the tick marks and the needle. From the buoy, concentric ripples spread out across the water surface, drawn as fine engraved off-white lines in the water itself: wide flattened ellipses seen in perspective, much wider than tall, the nearer arcs larger and bolder, the farther arcs thinner and fading into the wave lines, dying out well before the left third of the image. Richly detailed engraved nautical chart style, like a fine antique sea chart printed in two inks: the sea built from many layers of fine wave lines and hatching, line density increasing towards the deep water to give depth, tonal bands from deep cerulean at the bottom to lighter cerulean at the top, bathymetric contour lines with small depth soundings drawn as tiny dots, subtle foam strokes and a few glints of light on the crests. Every wave is drawn as visible engraved line work, like a steel engraving, never painted, never smooth. Crisp sharp lines of several weights, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant. No realistic objects, no photographic rendering, no glow, no gradient, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. The engraved sea fills the whole wide image edge to edge. The buoy is medium-small and sits in the right half of the image with water all around it; the entire left third of the image is completely calm open water with nothing in it, only quiet engraved wave lines. Palette strictly limited to medium cerulean ocean blue #0072a8 and its tints and shades, off-white #fbfcfd, ink grey #13212b and a touch of forest green #2F7A55 on the tip of the needle only.
